facts.fact: Teraco says NAPAfrica traffic peaked at 100 Gbps in 2016, 500 Gbps in 2018, 2 Tbps in 2021, over 4 Tbps in 2023 and 5 Tbps in February 2025.
Teraco says Akamai, Amazon, Cloudflare, Google, Meta, Microsoft and Netflix are present at NAPAfrica, and that Netflix Open Connect is hosted in Cape Town and Durban.
Teraco says NAPAfrica operates exchange points in Johannesburg, Cape Town and Durban, with over 655 members from over 50 countries.
